purpose: Lists an organization's employees inline and in a searchable sheet.
namedChanges: the imports are the peers': `findByAttribute`, `AttributeFindResult`, `mapWithConcurrency`, `MAX_PARALLEL_DEREFERENCES`, `typeLocalName` from `lws-vault-sets`; `readRecord` from `lws-records`; `photoRefFromFacts` from `photo-term`; `vaultOriginOf` from `vault-origin-rule`; `partyNameOf`, `personKindNamesOf` from `stakeholder-card-model`; `cardMasterSource`, `readStakeholderCardVocabulary`, `readStoredCardVocabulary` from `stakeholder-card-vocabulary`; `masterKindReader` from `plan-stakeholder-io`; `attributeSpelling` from `term-slots`; `idFromResourceUri` from `resource-id`; `CardGroup` from `card-group`; `useDebouncedValue` from `record-picker`; `eventTargetInTopDialog`, `modalIsOpen` from `open-popups`; `subjectSpellings`, `inVault` and `refsOf`, `servedValue` are the unit's own pure copies (`src/subjectSpellings.ts`, `src/servedValue.ts`);

interface `OrgEmployeesHost` (with `ReadResource`, `EmploymentLinkVocab`, `RecordFaceProps`) and the context `OrgEmployeesHostContext` with `useOrgEmployeesHost()` are added; `readOrgEmployeesPage(...)` takes the host as its new first argument and the default `defaultDeps` is `defaultDepsOf(host)`, whose `readResources`, `photoReadKeys` and `resolveEmploymentLinkVocab` are `host.readResources(uris, vaultId)`, `host.photoReadKeys()` and `host.resolveEmploymentLinkVocab()` with the same arguments, at the same places;
`OrgEmployeeRow` reads `RecordFace` from the host and draws it only when the host gives one (absent: no face is drawn, the name and titles still show and the row still opens the person);
`OrgShortList` reads `useSheetHistory` and `dropStaleSheetEntry` from the host, called at the same places as the source called its own; `useOrgEmployees` passes the host to `readOrgEmployeesPage`;
comments made generic (cycle, step, tester and ruling tags, dates, person names and app names removed); no other code change.
